text: {"lessons":["Buying more shares of every stock in back-to-back periods left me with a larger, concentrated set of positions; I should size each holding deliberately and keep room for cash.","Selling some Stock B after a strong gain was a useful reminder to set exit or rebalancing rules in advance, rather than deciding from a recent price move alone.","My account value later fell sharply despite earlier gains, so I should expect volatility and judge progress against my ten-year apartment goal, not a few months of returns."]}
